baseline.message: test(sync): record blocked staging synchronization smoke

rootCause.readerGap: GitHubActivityReader.listCommits has no typed target SHA and GitHub REST query omits sha
rootCause.falseTerminal: a non-default-branch push can refresh default-branch commits and mark SyncRun completed without the pushed after SHA

design.format: exactly 40 lowercase hexadecimal characters and not the all-zero deletion sentinel
design.scope: present only for github.push.v1 / push webhook lineage; null for every other webhook kind
design.reader: GitHubCommitReadRequest accepts optional targetSha; other five readers retain GitHubActivityReadRequest
design.missingTarget: fail the SyncRun with existing safe github_activity_not_found and keep delivery out of completed

tddRed: reject uppercase, malformed and all-zero push after SHA
preserve strict internal-event exact keys while accepting a canonical push githubObjectId
derive pushAfterSha only for a consistent push kind/event pair
strictly parse new and legacy BackgroundJob lineage with non-push target null
add encoded sha only to commit endpoint when target exists
pass target only to commit group
fail SyncRun and delivery when target is absent from returned commits
complete and preserve replay semantics when target is present

requiredGates.directUnitAndIntegration: all selected tests pass with no required skip
requiredGates.fullUnit: all files and tests pass; report denominator and skip
requiredGates.applicationIntegration: required skip 0, with at most one equivalent retry for a proven local environment failure
requiredGates.database: full local pgTAP, db lint, generated types check and drift check pass
requiredGates.staticAndE2E: lint, typecheck, module boundaries, production E2E and git diff check pass

forbidden: Push, deployment, PR, release or workflow
migration, schema, RLS or generated database type changes
raw webhook payload, secret, token, cookie or authorization persistence
dependency, lockfile, UI or unrelated refactor
commitPolicy: exactly one new local commit; no amend, rebase, force or Push
